headline: Fish Processing Quality Aide
summary: Fish processing quality aide with three years at a Bicol seafood plant. I check the freshness and handling of fish from landing to packing, follow hygienic practices on the processing floor and make sure products meet food safety and quality standards before they are packed.
skills: Seafood processing: smoked, dried and frozen fish
Food safety and food safety principles

experience.title: Fish Processing Quality Aide
bullets: Check fish at receiving for freshness, temperature and damage, and reject poor lots.
Watch hygiene on the processing floor: handwashing, clean tools and ice use.
Check smoked, dried and frozen products against quality standards before packing.
Inspect packs for seal, weight and labelling and record the results.

experience.title: Fish Processing Worker
bullets: Cleaned, salted and dried fish for the cooperative's products.
